## Brand & Style

This design system is engineered for floor leads, general managers, and operational directors operating in high-velocity retail environments. It bridges raw sensor telemetry—such as dwell times, heatmaps, live queue bottlenecks, and autonomous inventory scanning—with split-second decision-making. 

The aesthetic is precision-engineered, atmospheric, and command-center driven. It borrows from aerospace glass cockpits and advanced developer telemetry consoles, rendered through deep obsidian backdrops, ultra-crisp micro-typography, and restrained luminescent status indicators. Every element feels low-latency, active, and strictly purposeful, turning sensory overload into decisive real-time control.

## Colors

The palette establishes an absolute visual hierarchy calibrated for high-density, dim, or variable retail floor lighting. Dark values are meticulously layered to prevent eye fatigue while preserving sharp spatial separation.

- **Foundations**: Canvas background is `#090a0f` (deep void), elevated surfaces sit on `#0f1117` (obsidian charcoal), and interactive floating cards occupy `#161922`. Structural card delineation relies on crisp `#262a38` borders.
- **Status & Telemetry Accents**:
  - **Live / Nominal / Positive**: `#10b981` (emerald) paired with `#00f2fe` (electric cyan) for live data streaming, active beacons, and positive conversion metrics.
  - **Warning / Congestion / Threshold**: `#f59e0b` (luminescent amber) for queue latency spikes and inventory replenishment alerts.
  - **Critical / Stockout / Emergency**: `#ef4444` (vivid crimson) for instant operational escalations.
- **Data Demarcation & Secondary Elements**: `#64748b` and `#94a3b8` provide muted slate tones for grid axes, timestamps, unit labels, and inactive states.

## Typography

Typography pairs geometric structure with industrial readouts:
- **Headlines (`spaceGrotesk`)**: Provides an authoritative, technical profile for store zones, aggregate summaries, and critical module titles.
- **Interface Body (`inter`)**: Optimized for high-density scanning and neutral readability across logs and manager action notes.
- **Telemetry & Labels (`jetbrainsMono`)**: Governs counts, sensor IDs, time deltas, financial numbers, and status badges. Tabular figures ensure aligned vertical columns without dynamic horizontal jitter during live telemetry updates.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built for maximum spatial density without visual clutter, enabling one-handed mobile auditing alongside comprehensive multi-display command monitors.

- **Grid Architecture**: 
  - **Mobile (< 768px)**: 4-column fluid layout with `0.75rem` outer margins and compact `0.5rem` to `0.75rem` gutters. Metric cards arrange into 2-column micro-grids or single-column stacked telemetry feeds.
  - **Tablet (768px – 1024px)**: 8-column layout allowing floor heatmaps and live telemetry cards to sit side-by-side.
  - **Desktop (> 1024px)**: 12-column fixed/proportional grid with `1.5rem` margins and an expandable situational awareness rail.
- **Rhythm & Density**: Vertical spacing relies on tight 4px and 8px base progressions to prioritize data-over-whitespace, ensuring critical alerts and primary metrics remain above the fold.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is established strictly through dark tonal layering and selective luminescence rather than traditional dropped shadows:

- **Surface Levels**:
  - **Base Canvas**: `#090a0f`
  - **Module Level 1**: `#0f1117` with `1px solid #262a38`
  - **Card Level 2**: `#161922` with `1px solid #262a38`
  - **Overlay / Modal Level 3**: `#1c202d` with a luminous `1px solid #3b4257`
- **Luminescence & Status Glow**:
  - Interactive elements and alert boundaries use soft colored ambient drop shadows (`0 0 16px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)` for green, `0 0 16px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2)` for amber, and `0 0 20px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25)` for crimson).
  - Telemetry cards housing real-time anomalies feature a top-edge accent line with an integrated radial highlight.

## Shapes

The geometric architecture balances modern ergonomics with high-density data containers:
- Large analytical panels and surface cards utilize `rounded-2xl` (1rem to 1.5rem radius) to soften complex data visualizations.
- Interactive controls, nested metric boxes, and micro-badges use standard `rounded-lg` (0.5rem) or `rounded-md` (0.375rem) to maximize interior data real estate.
- Pulsing status pips and binary toggle indicators use full circular or pill radii.

## Components

- **Telemetry Cards**: Built with `rounded-2xl` corners, `#161922` background, and `1px solid #262a38`. Features a localized header zone hosting the metric title, JetBrains Mono readout, dynamic sparkline, and a micro-status pill.
- **Buttons**:
  - **Primary Operational Action**: Electric emerald (`#10b981`) background, deep charcoal text (`#090a0f`), semi-bold weight, subtle emerald edge glow on hover/active.
  - **Secondary / Tactical**: Translucent `#161922` with `1px solid #262a38` and slate text (`#94a3b8`), transitioning to `#00f2fe` border on focus.
  - **Critical Alert Action**: Crimson fill (`#ef4444`) with white text and urgent high-visibility strobe or static glow.
- **Micro-Badges & Status Tags**: Monospaced, uppercase micro-badges using 10% opacity tints of the status color with full-saturation text and a 1px border matching the accent (e.g., `#10b9811a` background, `#10b981` text).
- **Inputs & Filters**: Compact, dark inset styling (`#0f1117`) with `1px solid #262a38`. On focus, shifts to a razor-sharp `#00f2fe` border with a subtle 2px cyan ambient bloom.
- **Lists & Sensor Feed Rows**: Flush, borderless list rows with subtle alternating hovers (`#1c202d`). Values right-align in monospace numbers; timestamps render in muted `#64748b`.
- **Live Floor Beacons & Heatmap Nodes**: Circular status rings with synchronized pulsing outer waves for real-time customer tracking and queue dwell markers.
